exposure: Head descent parameters (progression distance, head-to-perineum distance, angle of progression)
Gestational weeks 37, 38, 41, and the week before delivery
cohort: This study included 276 low-risk, primiparous women at term.
finding: Progression distance and body mass index measured at 37 to 38 weeks' gestation correlate with the mode of delivery and can potentially be used to predict the mode of delivery at term.
